name: wf-inventory-update

actions.name: Parse_InventoryFlatFile
actions.behavior: Built-in Flat File Decoding reads BizTalk flat-file annotations for one HDR plus repeating DTL CRLF records; invalid structure fails the whole interchange because recoverable interchange processing is false

ordering: Strictly sequential Flat File Decoding, transform, and upload. Output XSD conformance is tested offline rather than enforced by a source-absent runtime validation action. One workflow replaces the receive-port subscription and no orchestration trigger is invented.
retryErrorBehavior: Flat File Decoding or map failures fail the run without partial record recovery. Upload retries three times at five-minute intervals; terminal handling is gated.

inputs.name: InventorySnapshot
inputs.structure: HDR then repeating DTL records, comma-delimited, CRLF-delimited

configurationNeeds: Key Vault-backed settings if secrets are introduced

network.recommendation: Owner may evaluate IP restrictions or private networking in a later approved change.
